title: Whistle!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Sho Kazamatsuri, cut from his school soccer team for being too short, transfers to Josui Junior High, where he is mistakenly introduced as a star player; when the truth comes out he trains alone, working twice as hard, and grows into a team leader (Viz blurbs via AniList and MangaUpdates). A 24-volume middle-school soccer series with tournaments and rivalries.
life_message: It holds up hard work, honesty and teamwork as the way to reach a dream despite physical limits.

content.note: Rejection for his height; dead and adoptive parents in backstories (MangaUpdates Dead Parent/s, Adopted Child/ren).
Letting a false reputation stand leads to trouble (blurb).

frames.aligns: Sho's perseverance and honesty after the mistaken-star mix-up.
Humble, disciplined effort after being rejected for his height.
frames.concerns: Ambition for glory could feed pride.

frames.aligns: Diligence and teamwork at Josui Junior High.
Overcoming limits through effort is an easy faith conversation.

frames.concerns: Glory in self rather than God.

frames.aligns: Serving the team as a calling.
Steady discipline and mutual accountability on the team.

frames.concerns: Competitive rivalry and worldly sport culture.

frames.aligns: Inclusion of a player others wrote off.
Effort without giving up, close to karma yoga.
Right effort and humility after rejection.
Challenges exclusion based on body size.

frames.concerns: Tournaments may fall on the Sabbath, a family talking point.

frames.aligns: Worth of every player regardless of size.
Unity and service in a team.

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Rivalry settled on the field by rules (MangaUpdates Tournament/s).

Order vs freedom.evidence: Team discipline and training regimens (MangaUpdates Training, Teamwork).

Civic vs kin.evidence: School team as the community; family backstories secondary (tags).

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Team captaincy and seniority; Sho becomes a leader (AniList blurb).

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Practical training and strategy, no religious frame.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Pursuing a personal dream through hard work (Viz blurb).

folkways.japan: Reflects Japanese school club culture, with senpai-kohai seniority and the team as a group one serves.

delivery.evidence: No review found; blurbs show the message carried by Sho's training arc (to verify).
delivery.note: The effort-and-teamwork message is carried by the sports plot.

winners_losers: Hard-working, honest players win respect; the view that small players cannot compete loses.
to_verify: Any romance, language or bullying content; no review was opened.
